title: Stave snapshot plan entry
description: Per-file row in the JSON output of `stave snapshot plan --format json`. Stave produces this plan as a recommendation; external tools (cron scripts, Terraform null_resource, CI cleanup jobs) parse the JSON and execute the actions. Stave never deletes, moves, or archives files itself.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the snapshot file on the host that produced the plan. Authoritative target for any external delete/archive command.

rel_path.description: Path relative to the observations_root field on the parent envelope. Useful for logs and per-tier rollups; may not be unique when observations span multiple roots.

asset_id.description: Stave's asset identifier extracted from the snapshot's first asset, on a best-effort basis. Empty string when the snapshot loader could not parse the file.

asset_type.description: Stave's asset-type identifier (e.g. `aws_s3_bucket`) extracted from the snapshot's first asset. Empty when no asset metadata is available.

captured_at.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp recorded inside the observation file.

age.description: Compact human-readable age relative to the plan's generated_at — e.g. `34d`, `5h`, `2m`. For arithmetic use age_seconds.

age_seconds.description: Age in seconds since captured_at, rounded toward zero.

tier.description: Retention tier name resolved from project config (observation_tier_mapping rules).

action.description: Recommended fate of the snapshot. Plan emits `keep` or `delete`; the inventory command produces the full vocabulary.

reason.description: Human-readable justification for the action — e.g. `older than 720h0m0s threshold`, `within keep_min floor`.
